## Cost analysis

**Forced floor = 5; rot180 is NOT perfect-25.** Cost = memory + params. (1) Single-node is forced: any ≥2-node reversal materializes a full-canvas [1,10,30,30] F32 intermediate = 36,240 B billed memory (Range+2Gather profiled 36,243). (2) Reversal always needs a mandatory geometry payload; cheapest single-node both-axis reverse = RoiAlign/MaxRoiPool at 5, Slice at 8, Conv/MatMul/Einsum/GridSample ≥900. Full argument + irreducibility proof: `task087/hard_records/rot180_perfect25_ceiling.md`. **WALL at 5.**
